text.en:
There is hereby established at the University of the Philippines at Los Baños and "Agricultural
and Rural Development Scholarship Fund" to support a selected number of qualified and deserving students
from the rural and farming sector of the country.

The sum of Five Million Pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury
annually for a period of ten years beginning Fiscal Year 1978 to constitute the Agricultural and Rural
Development Scholarship Fund at the U.P. at Los Baños. The fund shall be a Special Trust fund to be
deposited or invested and the earnings thereof, but not the capital, to be utilized exclusively for the purpose of
this Decree.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
